meta.mascot_note: config/thumbnail-illustration.md §3 고정 사양 — 미색 원형 머리·머리카락 없음·코 없음·검은 점 눈·짧은 선 입·안경 없음. 감정은 눈썹으로만. 9장 전부 머리는 동일하고 복장·자세·눈썹만 바뀐다(몸은 바뀌고 머리는 안 바뀐다). 머리 크기는 화면 높이의 약 3분의 1로 실사형(55~60%)보다 작다.
meta.gate_note: config/thumbnail-design.md 게이트 A·B·C·D를 9장 전부 통과. 금액은 verified-data.md 실측치만 사용 — 2억→1억 800만원(-9,200만원, -46%) / 298만 7,000원(6·25 장중 최고가) / 1,420,000원(8·10 종가) / 매도 30,900,000원(금감원 민원 사례) / 6월 수출 141조원. 구도 배분은 §4대로 좌우 대비 4장(1·3·4·5), 은유 2장(2·6), 계승 3장(7~9).
meta.ban_note: 이 편 금지 — 백발 노인·관공서·연금 서류 / 실명 반도체 종목 로고 / 매수 권유로 읽힐 상승 화살표. 마스코트는 무연령·무성이므로 「나 같은 사람」 게이트를 복장과 상황으로만 만든다.
meta.prompt_suffix: Style: a richly rendered, volumetric semi-3D digital illustration in the visual language of Korean finance-explainer YouTube thumbnails — dimensional forms with real weight, believable materials (brushed metal, glass, brick, paper, fabric, gold), soft ambient occlusion and glossy highlights; every surface has thickness, weight and a light side and a shadow side. A golden sunset or a strong warm key light burns behind the scene and floods it with orange and gold, while the opposite side falls into deep near-black shadow, so the tonal range runs from almost pure black to bright highlight inside one frame. Colours are vivid and poster-like: gold and orange for the winning side, saturated red for loss and danger, saturated green for gain. The frame is CROWDED — signboards, floating panels, round badges, bar charts, thick arrows, stacks of gold coins, cash bundles, brand-free shopping and office props stacked into every part of the upper picture the way a busy movie poster is, and yet the main figure and the main number still read instantly at thumbnail size. CHARACTER SHEET, identical in every image: a large smooth round off-white head with no hair and no nose, rendered with soft three-dimensional shading and a clean dark outline, always the brightest face in the picture; two big white eyes with round black pupils and visible eyelids; thick solid black eyebrows that change angle with the emotion; a drawn mouth that opens and bends with the emotion; a small simple body in situation clothing with simple rounded hands. If the scene contains more than one person, every one of them is the SAME character with the same head, differing only in clothing, pose and expression; many scenes have only one. Render only the Korean words quoted above; every other surface stays free of lettering.
meta.style_note: 2026-08-20 2차 전면 개정 — 1차는 기존 씬에 색만 얹어 전혀 닮지 않았다. 경제해적단 복제 사양으로 9장 전부 백지 재작성. 규칙: config/thumbnail-illustration.md §2·§3

thumbnails.concept_ko: 오프닝 5단 ③ '같은 날 같은 반도체를 산 두 사람'을 마스코트 두 몸으로 세웠다. 갈린 변수는 종목이 아니라 빌린 돈이다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 아바타 2인(무연령·무성) [B 금액] 좌 표지판 "1억 800만원", 우 표지판 "0원" [C 사건] 오른쪽 발밑 지면이 지금 갈라져 내려앉는 중 [D 주어] 두 결말 모두 내 계좌다 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목의 어구를 옮기지 않고 결과 숫자만 맡는다
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the scene continues all the way down to the bottom edge of the 16:9 frame as one unbroken illustration. The bottom three-eighths is the SAME scene carrying on — the same road, floor, pavement or table surface with its own drawn texture, joints and perspective — only sunk into deep shadow so it reads as a quiet dark area. It is NOT a black bar, NOT a letterbox band, NOT a flat colour block and NOT an empty panel; the drawing must be visible inside that shadow. Keep it quiet by putting nothing important there: no head, no face, no hand, no signboard, no badge, no chart and no bright object. Every character is cut off at the waist by the top of that shadowed area, and every head, hand, sign, badge, chart and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. Counters, sills, road surfaces and machine shelves all run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. The upper five-eighths is bright, warm, saturated and PACKED with detail — buildings, trees, vehicles, small distant figures, shop fronts, poles and wires fill every part of it so no area of the picture is empty. The mascot's off-white head stays fully lit and light-toned, never sunk into shadow. Scene: a wide road splitting into two at a golden sunset, seen straight on, a tall green highway signboard standing in the centre of the frame reading "반도체" in large white Korean Hangul with "6월 25일 → 7월 30일" on a smaller line beneath it. The LEFT half is a dark storm-lit road jammed with a red barrier arm down across it; a round red badge the size of a car wheel hangs above it reading "-46%", and a white panel on a post shows a red bar chart plunging with a thick red arrow, labelled "2억 → 1억 800만원" in Korean Hangul. The RIGHT half is an open golden road running toward the burning sunset, a green badge above it reading "버틴 쪽" and a white panel showing a flat green line with the label "1억 800만원" in Korean Hangul, stacks of gold coins piled at the roadside. The mascot stands in the very centre in front of the signboard in a dark suit, one gloved hand raised to its chin, thick black eyebrows drawn down into a hard V, big white eyes narrowed and looking straight at the viewer, mouth a tight determined line. Behind the barrier on the dark left side a crowd of four identical mascots in creased suits stumble and stagger, hands on their heads, mouths open in dismay, sheets of paper flying around them; on the golden right side two more of the same character stroll away toward the light with easy posture.
